questions.qtext: Two parents go with their three kids to the theater, and they have tickets for five consecutive seats. How many sitting arrangements would there be if the only rule is that the two parents want to sit together?
questions.solution:
Answer: 4

Source solution 1 (score: 0)
If the parents are to sit together we can consider them to form a single block. In other words, up to permuting the two parents, arranging the seatings of the couple with the $3$ kids is equivalent to the same task with $4$ kids and no parents. This would give us $4 ! $ permutations. Accounting for the $2 !$ permutations of the parents, our final answer is $4 ! \times 2 !=48$.
